text:
Anya Gupta: AM tidewatch — pushed kernel slot-rebalancer PR (https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/482). bench numbers look promising, p50 down ~9%.
Joe Park: nice. can you add a short changelog entry? will do quick CR after breakfast.
Anya Gupta: yep adding notes now. pinging @Joe for the hot path review (small loop change, ~30 LOC).
Priya Nair: quick heads-up — saw a small spike in KV eviction on canary yesterday 03:12 UTC (evict_count 120 -> 230 in 10m). not sure if it's related to rebalancer.
Kai Chen: I ran the microbatch bench against the branch, p50 95ms -> 86ms, p95 is stable. used new batching heuristic + adaptive window.
Sam R.: I can take the eviction traces. Priya, can you paste the consumer logs? small snippet is fine.
Priya Nair: putting the snippet here: `2026-02-18T03:12:07Z kernel.eviction.evict_count=128 shard=12 reason=slot-rebalance` — then a burst of `reason=background-ttl` entries.
Sam R.: got it. will correlate with slot handoff logs.
Joe Park: CR done, left one comment about loop invariant + test. small change.
Anya Gupta: thanks @Joe. plan for rollout: canary (2 nodes) -> regional (5 nodes) -> global. will monitor p50/p95 and eviction rate.
deploy-bot: deploy job started for canary group "rebalancer-canary" (job id: dj-8842).
Kai Chen: after deploy I can run the microbatch harness: `./bench/run --concurrency 16 --seq-len 256 --profile` and capture KV metrics.
Priya Nair: blocker: I can't reproduce the eviction burst locally; only seen on one dedicated canary host. Sam, if you need creds for the host let me know.
Sam R.: I have access, will SSH and enable trace flags. if it's noisy I can add a temporary metric for `evict_reason` counts.
Anya Gupta: timeline: I will merge once the canary is stable for 30m and no eviction spikes. if we see regressions we roll back and iterate.
Joe Park: FYI I queued a follow-up PR to add an integration test for slot handoff. links: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/483
Kai Chen: noted. will post bench artifacts to the perf dashboard after run.
Priya Nair: thanks team — will update here with any traces.
Anya Gupta: ack :thumbsup:
